start_greeting: Welcome to the real estate bot! Choose a language to continue.
placeholder_language: Tap a flag code — or type UZ / RU / EN
placeholder_main_menu: Pick 🏠 or 🌐 — keyboard hides after use
placeholder_rooms: Tap a quick count or type any number…
placeholder_type: Tap 🧱🏢🏗 or type brick, panel, monolith…
placeholder_condition: Tap a mood or type new / good / needs_repair…
placeholder_confirm: Tap ✅ or ❌ — helper hides after choice
placeholder_address_inline: ⌨️ Type the street & city in the message bar.
placeholder_total_floors_inline: ⌨️ Type total floors as a whole number.
placeholder_region: Pick a region or send location
placeholder_district: Pick a district or type manually
err_invalid_language_selection: Please tap one of the language buttons below.
idle_unknown_action: Please use the menu buttons below.
err_type: That value is not recognized. Use the buttons or type: brick, panel, monolith.
err_condition: That value is not recognized. Use the buttons or type: new, good, needs_repair.
welcome: Welcome! Quick actions below — swipe keyboard down to hide.
main_menu_hint: What would you like to do?
ask_photos: Send at least 2 photos of the property (you can send several in one batch).
